pages.title: Spread
pages.creator: VeltosAI
pages.description: Expand a colored territory in Spread. Choose a color to absorb neighboring connected cells while a rival grows outward from the opposite corner. Plan each selection around the available colors and finish with the larger share when the board has been claimed.

pages.title: PaperWar.io
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Claim unoccupied ground in PaperWar.io. Extend your territory across the map while watching rivals who can interrupt the expansion. Eliminate opponents that threaten the run, work toward controlling the whole field, and choose among nine available skins for the character.

pages.title: Fury Tanks
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Trade arcing shots across uneven ground in Fury Tanks. Hold and release to fire, adjusting the angle and strength to reach the enemy tank. Improve health, armor, and damage between encounters to prepare for the next exchange over the hills.

pages.title: Aim Ninja
pages.creator: Siddhant Sharma
pages.description: Stop an indicator at the right moment in Aim Ninja. Click, tap, or press Space as the moving needle reaches the desired position. Accurate timing adds points and provides another opportunity to improve the result during the next pass.

pages.title: Pool Master
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Clear pool tables across a hundred stages in Pool Master. Aim the cue and pocket balls while working around closed pockets and special ball requirements. Collect coins to improve cues and obtain boosts as the layouts demand more precise shots.

pages.title: Dinosaur Shifting Run
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Change forms to match the terrain in Dinosaur Shifting Run. Choose a dinosaur suited to the current environment and use its movement to pass the obstacles ahead. Switch again when the route changes to stay ahead of the competing runners.

pages.title: 21 Cards
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Make exact totals in 21 Cards. Draw a card and place it into one of the columns, checking the running value before adding another. A total of twenty-one clears the column and awards points, while exceeding the target spoils the planned combination.

pages.title: Sword and Jewel
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Place jewels into matching lines in Sword and Jewel. Arrange at least three identical gems in a row or column to remove them and make space. Keep new placements possible as the board fills, since losing every move ends the puzzle.

pages.title: Red Stickman vs Craftmans
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Fight block-world monsters in Red Stickman vs Craftmans. Run and jump across platforms, use Space to strike enemies, and reach the portal at the end of the stage. Gather coins to improve the stick figure's abilities before later encounters.

pages.title: Hitman Sniper
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: Take precision shooting assignments in Hitman Sniper. Use the first-person view to line up criminal targets and eliminate them from a distance. Locate the threats required by the encounter and choose a clear shot before continuing to the next objective.

pages.title: Doggo Drop
pages.creator: Digital Will Inc.
pages.description: Drop numbered pieces with a Shiba Inu in Doggo Drop. Aim for landings that bring matching blocks together, creating larger values through merges. Consider where the next piece can fit while building toward a stronger score in the falling-block puzzle.

pages.title: Real GT Racing Simulator
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Race detailed cars through circuit challenges in Real GT Racing Simulator. Steer with the movement keys, brake for turns, and activate boost when another stretch allows it. Tune the vehicle and use the reposition control when you need to recover the car's place on the track.

pages.title: Solitaire Klondike - Treasure Island
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Clear pirate-themed card deals in Solitaire Klondike - Treasure Island. Build four suit foundations upward from ace to king while arranging seven tableau stacks in descending, alternating colors. Move card groups to uncover hidden pieces and use boosters during the island adventure.

pages.title: Elevator Fight
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Win close-quarters bouts in Elevator Fight. Attack and dodge inside the confined lift, defeating the opponent to ride up another floor. Improve the fighter's speed, power, and defense while working through more than a hundred and thirty encounters.

pages.title: Snow Race 3d Fun Racing
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Build a route upward in Snow Race 3d Fun Racing. Gather snow into a large ball, then use it to construct stairs toward a higher section of the course. Compete with opponents collecting their own snow and keep building toward the race's finish.

pages.title: Gold Miner Tower Defense
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Protect a miner's treasure in Gold Miner Tower Defense. Choose defensive towers and use card-based decisions to strengthen the route against incoming enemies. Upgrade the formation as the attacks continue, keeping the gold out of the opposing force's reach.

pages.title: Earthquake io
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Grow a destructive force in Earthquake io. Move through a city breaking buildings and smaller objects, increasing the scale of the devastation. Compete against other players to become larger while working toward destroying the whole urban area.

pages.title: Super Bitcoin Boy
pages.creator: Rich Games
pages.description: Cross cryptocurrency-themed platform stages in Super Bitcoin Boy. Guide the character around obstacles, defeat enemies, and collect bitcoin-shaped pickups along the route. Finish the levels while gathering more of the virtual coins to improve the score.

pages.title: Alien Hunters
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Sneak up on opponents in Alien Hunters. Tap a position to move the robot hunter, approaching enemies from behind to strike with its light dagger. Remove every target in the area to complete the assignment and begin another mission.

pages.title: Picture Puzzles
pages.creator: NovaSky
pages.description: Reassemble images with adjustable layouts in Picture Puzzles. Choose a picture and increase or reduce the number of pieces before beginning. Connect the scattered sections using their outlines and visual details until the selected image is complete.

pages.title: Stickman Ragdoll Playground
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: Experiment with a physics-driven character in Stickman Ragdoll Playground. Move the ragdoll around the play area and try its interactions with the surrounding objects. Use the color palette to change its appearance while exploring how different movements affect the body's reactions.

pages.title: Merge in Space
pages.creator: Fast Games
pages.description: Combine celestial objects in Merge in Space. Tap to drop an astronomical piece into the playfield and bring identical objects together as they descend. Plan the placement around the developing pile so another useful merge remains possible.

pages.title: Princess Royal Wedding
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Prepare two royal brides in Princess Royal Wedding. Help the princesses choose outfits for their ceremonies with Kristoff and Jack, comparing dresses and coordinating accessories. Complete each bride's appearance before the couples' wedding celebration begins.

pages.title: Amazing Airplane Racer
pages.creator: Zyrex Games
pages.description: Pilot a plane through competitive courses in Amazing Airplane Racer. Steer around the route and collect power-ups such as turbo and shields to challenge the other racers. Two players have separate movement controls for sharing the airborne race.

pages.title: Pop Adventure
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Clear colored groups in Pop Adventure. Fire bubbles toward matching pieces and form combinations of at least three to make them burst. Remove every bubble required by the screen to finish the mission and collect its reward.

pages.title: World Tank Wars
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Hold a base against growing assaults in World Tank Wars. Choose a tank, improve its performance, and recruit allies before heading into battle. Survive successive enemy waves and invest in stronger vehicles as the attackers become more powerful.

pages.title: Color Blocks - Relax Puzzle
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Claim a pattern with falling pieces in Color Blocks - Relax Puzzle. Place starting dominoes so their chain reaction covers more of the design in your color. Compare your route with the opponent's existing pieces and plan a placement that gives your side the larger area.

pages.title: Assassin Ninja Rush
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Dash through enemy positions in Assassin Ninja Rush. Hold and drag to aim a rush route, then release to send the ninja along it. Dodge bullets, break crates for health, and unlock characters or weapons with completed levels and earned coins.

pages.title: Celebrity Halloween Costumes
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Put together festive disguises in Celebrity Halloween Costumes. Help the celebrity characters compare clothing and accessories for their group of Halloween looks. Finish each outfit with matching details before the friends reveal their selected costumes together.

pages.title: Candy Land
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Restore access to lemonade in Candy Land. Remove or replace transparent yellow blocks, move bridges, and press switches to guide the red and blue jellies toward their drink. Work through each arrangement's mechanisms to reopen the blocked route.

pages.title: Idle Mine&Merge
pages.creator: XiferGames
pages.description: Dig and improve equipment in Idle Mine&Merge. Defeat enemies and bosses for money, buy weapons or tools, and combine matching items into stronger versions. Start another digging expedition with the upgraded gear to uncover more underground blocks.

pages.title: St Patrick's Day Princess Challenge
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Create green-themed looks in St Patrick's Day Princess Challenge. Style Tiana, Ariel, and Harley Quinn with clothing and makeup for the holiday. Use rainbow eyeshadow, shamrock details, glitter, and other available accents to complete their different appearances.

pages.title: Stickman Supreme Shooter
pages.description: Fight other stick figures in Stickman Supreme Shooter. Move through the stages with firearms and a bazooka, switching equipment as the encounters change. Reload, crouch, and adjust the camera to keep the fighter in a useful position against the enemies.

pages.title: Pick & Match
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Reveal animal pairs in Pick & Match. Open cards to find identical pictures and remember the locations of partners already seen. Clear every pair before time expires to complete the level and collect the rewards for the finished board.

pages.title: Great Air Battle
pages.creator: GameEon Studios
pages.description: Take aircraft into two-dimensional dogfights in Great Air Battle. Choose among planes such as fighters and bombers, then steer through the battlefield while attacking enemy jets. Keep the aircraft moving around incoming threats as the aerial encounters continue.

pages.title: Super Car Extreme Car Driving
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Explore a city through driving assignments in Super Car Extreme Car Driving. Choose a sports car and complete missions that award rewards for the next improvements. Customize the available vehicles and test their handling through further tasks around the city.

pages.title: Offline Rogue
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Descend toward a dangerous cult leader in Offline Rogue. Fight villains, avoid traps, and work through the dungeon's trials as the last surviving rogue. Reach the lower depths and defeat the Cultist and other bosses to complete the adventure.

pages.title: Rocky Rampage
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Recover stolen clothing in Rocky Rampage. Help Boulder Cobblestone and Pebble chase the missing Wonderpants pieces, boosting the hero along the route and collecting useful items. Improve features such as extra lives or rocket power to extend later attempts.

pages.title: Star Cube
pages.creator: SNSHUB
pages.description: Collect a stage's stars in Star Cube. Click to jump onto the opposite white line, timing the transfer around the route ahead. Gather every star needed to clear the level while keeping the cube away from deadly red lines.

pages.title: Swipe The Pin
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Fill a container through pin puzzles in Swipe The Pin. Remove pins in an order that releases colored balls into the glass case below. Check which passages each pin opens before letting the next group fall, then continue once the container's requirement is met.

pages.title: Yummy Churros Ice Cream
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Prepare a customized dessert in Yummy Churros Ice Cream. Follow the task list through making the churros and ice cream, then choose a flavor. Finish with syrups and toppings, completing the listed activities to unlock the game's achievements.

pages.title: Besties Paris Trip
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Style three friends for a trip in Besties Paris Trip. Browse the wardrobes for Emma, Mi, and Sophie and choose outfits for their plans in Paris. Complete each look with accessories before the group leaves to meet their boyfriends.

pages.title: Walking Monsters
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Defend against attackers on both sides in Walking Monsters. Aim the gun at zombies approaching from the front and behind while watching for threats arriving from above. Keep switching attention between directions so the surrounding enemies cannot overwhelm the lone shooter.

pages.title: BFF Ballroom Dance Outfits
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Choose formal looks in BFF Ballroom Dance Outfits. Help the princesses compare elegant clothing for a dance party, coordinating accessories with each outfit. Complete their individual styling choices before the group is ready for the ballroom event.

pages.title: Tennis Masters
pages.creator: MadPuffers
pages.description: Challenge a friend or computer opponent in Tennis Masters. Move around the court, return shots, and time a smash to pressure the other side. Collect power-ups and unusual transformations that change the match while the two players contest each point.

pages.title: Super Jewel Collapse
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Clear board objectives within a move limit in Super Jewel Collapse. Select groups of matching jewels to remove them and complete the current stage's challenge. Finish efficiently for bonus points while progressing through forty-five different arrangements.

pages.title: Spinner Io
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Knock spinning rivals off an arena in Spinner Io. Use the joystick to steer the top and collide with other players, sending both objects bouncing. Keep your own spinner on the platform and remain until the final opponents have been pushed away.

pages.title: DAB Unicorns Puzzle
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Assemble a collection of dancing creatures in DAB Unicorns Puzzle. Choose among twelve unicorn pictures and move their scattered sections into matching positions. Reconnect the outlines and colors until the image of the dabbing unicorn is complete.

pages.title: Wobble Man Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Sneak between patrols in Wobble Man Online. Collect the key needed to open the next door while staying outside the guards' red-marked sight zones. Slide to guide the character through each room and reach the exit without being detected.

pages.title: Ambulance Trucks Differences
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Compare emergency-vehicle pictures in Ambulance Trucks Differences. Find seven changed details between the two scenes before time expires. Inspect the ambulance and its surroundings, selecting the remaining differences until the level's search is complete.

pages.title: Doll House Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Paint illustrated scenes in Doll House Coloring Book. Select a picture and apply the colors you prefer to its separate areas. Build the design section by section, combining shades and finishing the smaller details before completing the drawing.

pages.title: US Army Commando : Elite Commando War
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Carry out combat assignments in US Army Commando : Elite Commando War. Use assault rifles and sniper weapons to locate and eliminate enemy targets. Read the radar and line up the aim while working through the game's sequence of shooting missions.

pages.title: Parking Space
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description: Fit a car into a marked bay in Parking Space. Drive along the available road and adjust the approach to enter the parking area correctly. Stay within the route and finish the maneuver before the allotted time expires.

pages.title: Kids Memory with Insects
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Recognize and remember insect pictures in Kids Memory with Insects. Turn over cards, note the image revealed, and find its matching partner in another position. Clear the pairs while using remembered locations instead of relying on another guess.

pages.title: Jeep Parking Mania Airport
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Handle large vehicles around an airport in Jeep Parking Mania Airport. Steer a four-wheel-drive jeep through the parking missions and line it up with the designated position. Use the handbrake when needed to control the final approach around the surrounding traffic and barriers.

pages.title: Bill The Bowman
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Hit fruit above a volunteer in Bill The Bowman. Hold to aim the bow and release an arrow along the chosen trajectory. Keep the shot on the fruit rather than the person as the landscape changes and accurate streaks build a higher score.

pages.title: Christmas & Math
pages.creator: Jam Game Studio
pages.description: Judge arithmetic statements quickly in Christmas & Math. Choose the right or wrong button according to the equation shown on screen. Correct responses add points, while the increasing speed gives you less time to check the next festive math question.

pages.title: Flat Loaded Trucks Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Reveal vehicle pairs in Flat Loaded Trucks Hidden. Turn over tiles to find identical pictures, remembering earlier positions when a partner appears. Clear the cards across four memory levels and try to finish each arrangement in fewer moves.

pages.title: Dolphin Dice Race
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Race a dolphin around a board in Dolphin Dice Race. Take turns rolling the die and advance according to the result, using the special board routes to move ahead. Play on your own or share a hot-seat contest with a friend to reach the finish first.

pages.title: Endless Wavy Trip
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Keep a flying character on a winding route in Endless Wavy Trip. Use the mouse to manage its height and pass through the course's scoring circles. Collect gold during the flight and unlock additional characters while pursuing a longer run.

pages.title: Dunk Legend
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Shoot at changing basketball challenges in Dunk Legend. Drag to aim and release to send the ball toward the hoop, working around obstacles in the shot's path. Use power-ups and unlock additional balls while trying to complete more baskets.

pages.title: My Winter Wedding Dressup
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Prepare a bride for a cold-weather ceremony in My Winter Wedding Dressup. Compare wedding dresses and choose the other details needed for her outfit. Bring the selected pieces together to finish the bride's appearance before the celebration begins.

pages.title: 4x4 Xmas
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Reconstruct a seasonal image in 4x4 Xmas. Slide pieces next to the empty square until the board matches the reference picture on the right. The score decreases every second, rewarding a quicker sequence of moves through the scrambled layout.

pages.title: Baby Bath Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Assemble family-care scenes in Baby Bath Jigsaw. Complete puzzles at one of three difficulties to earn in-game money for more pictures. Drag pieces into their correct positions, with harder layouts providing larger rewards toward the next image purchase.

pages.title: Drift Scooter
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Ride along a busy route in Drift Scooter. Guide the scooter around incoming obstacles while collecting coins for points. Watch the road ahead and choose a clear line through traffic to keep the three-dimensional riding attempt going.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Fairyland
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Explore a magical realm in Baby Hazel Fairyland. Help Hazel search for the pink flower she promised to bring back to the magician. Interact with characters and objects throughout the fairyland adventure to continue toward the required gift.

pages.title: Fun Monsters Memory
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Clear creature-picture pairs in Fun Monsters Memory. Flip cards, remember their images, and return to the matching positions when a partner is found. Complete four layouts while trying to reduce the number of turns needed to reveal every pair.

pages.title: Gift Of Alchemy
pages.creator: Tasty Cherry
pages.description: Move symbols into their mapped positions in Gift Of Alchemy. Press a shape and slide it along the indicated direction until it fills the correct space and starts glowing. Continue aligning the remaining symbols to complete the alchemical pattern.

pages.title: Pixie Sauna Flirting
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Prepare a romantic evening in Pixie Sauna Flirting. Help Pixie shower and change before meeting her date, then guide the pair through conversations and kisses. Finish by choosing another outfit as the rest of their evening begins.

pages.title: Old Rusty Cars Differences
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Find changes in weathered vehicle pictures in Old Rusty Cars Differences. Compare the two scenes and click details that do not match before time expires. Use a hint if the remaining change is difficult to locate, with faster searches producing better scores.

pages.title: Little Heart Flying
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Guide a winged symbol through the sky in Little Heart Flying. Collect stars along the route while keeping the heart away from obstacles. Adjust its flight with the mouse and continue gathering points for as long as the path remains safe.

pages.title: Abstract Golf
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Aim for the cup in Abstract Golf. Drag to set the shot and release to strike the ball through the minimalist course. Judge the direction and strength carefully to complete each layout, pursuing a hole-in-one when the route allows it.

pages.title: Kids Coloring Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a drawing and build a palette in Kids Coloring Time. Select colors for the brush and fill the picture's separate sections. Combine the shades you want, finishing the details before moving on to another illustration in the coloring book.

pages.title: Rise To Sky
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Climb through an obstacle course in Rise To Sky. Steer the spacecraft past barriers and collect gems during the ascent. Spend the gathered currency on more ships and try another run through the hazards above.

pages.title: Toy Cars
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Explore different vehicle activities in Toy Cars. Drive eleven models, including a tank and helicopter, across free-roam, highway, or arena modes. Collect coins around the city, dodge road traffic, or attack opponents according to the challenge you choose.

pages.title: Space Attack
pages.creator: Vianim
pages.description: Pilot a spacecraft through alien encounters in Space Attack. Fire at hostile ships and keep the fighter moving through the battle to avoid being overwhelmed. Continue clearing the incoming enemies as the space-survival challenge presents another group of attackers.

pages.title: Princess Synchronized Swimming
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Prepare royal performers in Princess Synchronized Swimming. Choose swimsuits and coordinate jackets, ribbons, and medal details for their event looks. Compare the available costume pieces and finish a coordinated appearance for the princesses' swimming presentation.

pages.title: Yatzy Yam's
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Build combinations on a dice scorecard in Yatzy Yam's. Roll the dice, choose which results to keep, and use further rolls to pursue a useful scoring category. Decide where to record each result so the remaining categories can still contribute to the final total.

pages.title: Modern Combat Defense
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Hold a fortified position in Modern Combat Defense. Shoot the enemies advancing toward the base and earn improvements as the attacks continue. Buy stronger weapons and upgrades to handle the larger opponents arriving during later parts of the defense.

pages.title: Fat Shark
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Feed a hungry predator in Fat Shark. Eat fish to gain size, but steer carefully because a larger body makes bombs harder to avoid. Collect shrinking bonuses to restore the original size, and gather stars or hourglasses for extra points.

pages.title: Barbie and Ken Christmas
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help a couple prepare a holiday gathering in Barbie and Ken Christmas. Decorate the outside with lights and a wreath, then choose details for the tree and fireplace. Finish with coordinated festive outfits for Barbie and Ken before their guests arrive.

pages.title: Princesses Las Vegas Weekend
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Choose glamorous travel looks in Princesses Las Vegas Weekend. Help Anna and Elsa compare fashionable clothing from their suitcases and complete outfits for the trip. Add coordinating accessories before the sisters head out for their weekend in the city.

pages.title: Sery Actress Dolly Makeup
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Create a stage-ready look in Sery Actress Dolly Makeup. Open mystery boxes to reveal eyelashes, eyeshadows, and face-paint options, then choose details for the actress. Complete the makeup combination before Sery's first major appearance in the theater.

pages.title: My Summer Items
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Match holiday-item pictures in My Summer Items. Flip tiles to reveal their images, remembering where identical objects appeared. Clear every pair across three levels and try to finish each memory arrangement with fewer turns.

pages.title: Snail Bob 2 html5
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Help a small snail reach a family celebration in Snail Bob 2 html5. Operate buttons, levers, and bridges to create a safe route through the forest. Guide Bob past the hazards along the way as he continues toward his grandfather's birthday party.

pages.title: Foot Chinko: Euro 2016
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Play a goal-scoring pinball-style contest in Foot Chinko: Euro 2016. Choose a match and send the football through a field inspired by pachinko. Score goals while working around other players and disruptive spectators during the tournament-themed challenges.

pages.title: Rugby Down Hero
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Carry the play downfield in Rugby Down Hero. Guide the runner past opposing players, use power moves to take them down, and collect coins during the attempt. Complete objectives and unlock more characters while working toward longer runs through the defense.

pages.title: Jessica's Diary: Accidentally in Love
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Follow a romantic story in Jessica's Diary: Accidentally in Love. Help Jessica record the day a boy on a motorcycle rescued her from bullies. Use the mouse to work through the diary activity as she recounts the encounter and its effect on her feelings.

pages.title: The Heist
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Drive a getaway van through crime assignments in The Heist. Fight pursuing police for credits, limit heavy crashes that cost earnings, and spend the rewards on upgrades. Hold Shift to slow time when the road battle needs a more precise maneuver.

pages.title: Connect 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Find household-item pairs in Connect 2. Select matching icons and join them through an available path to remove them from the layout. Use the gaps created by earlier matches to find another connection and continue clearing the board.

pages.title: Lego Princesses
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Style block-built fairytale characters in Lego Princesses. Choose clothing and accessories for the princess figures, including Pocahontas, Elsa, Jasmine, and Moana. Complete their individual looks by comparing the wardrobe pieces available for each character.

pages.title: Bestman at Rapunzel Wedding
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Prepare two attendants for a ceremony in Bestman at Rapunzel Wedding. Choose formal outfits for the groomsmen, matching their suits with suitable shoes and other details. Finish both looks so they fit the wedding's dress style before the event begins.
